headline: Ghar ka tasty veg khana, bina kitchen mein ghante bitaye.
bio: Hi! Main Ananya Sharma. Swiggy-Zomato se thak gaye ho par cooking complex lagti hai? Main working professionals aur beginners ko simple veg Indian meals banana sikhati hun—wo bhi kam time aur basic pantry ingredients ke saath. Ab daily khane ka stress bilkul zero.
